name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Europa goes with exactly two of Okafor, Navigator, and Beacon.
Either Pilot goes with Forge or Lumen goes with Ganymede.
Between Echo and Forge, one goes with Bauer and the other with Luna.
Between Ganymede and Titan, one goes with Okafor and the other with Pilot.
Exactly two of these are true: Rios goes with Beacon; Captain goes with Forge; Pilot goes with Lumen.

hints.text: Suppose Captain went with Lumen — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Captain goes with Lumen.
Captain goes with Lumen, so it can't also go with Forge.
Lumen goes with Captain, so Pilot can't go with Lumen.
…but now the clue “Exactly two of these are true: Rios goes with Beacon; Captain goes with Forge; Pilot goes with Lumen” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Captain does not go with Lumen.
